title: Twelve independent-source NNSA cells remain separate from agency operating states
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: Eleven cells retain independent project-assessment state and one retains independent recommendation status without substituting agency evidence or promoting closure. Denominator: Eleven GAO project-assessment cells and one GAO recommendation-status cell.
key_findings: Finding: Eleven cells retain independent project-assessment state and one retains independent recommendation status without substituting agency evidence or promoting closure.

Boundary: No closure is inferred from publication.
